Case ID: 1101
Case Type: HR Request
Date: 2025-03-26
Handled By: HR - Caleb Nguyen
Customer or Requestor: Internal Employee - Sofia Mendes
Title: Correction of missed overtime in previous payroll

Issue Description
An employee in Customer Care reported that approved overtime from a weekend campaign shift did not appear on the most recent paycheck.

Steps Taken
- Compared approved timesheets, manager approval records, and the payroll export for the affected period.
- Found that the overtime code was approved after the standard cutoff because the manager used the wrong schedule group.
- Confirmed the hours were legitimate and that no prior manual adjustment had been submitted.
- Worked with Payroll to determine whether the correction met off-cycle payment criteria.

Resolution
Approved an off-cycle payroll correction for the missed overtime and documented the root cause in the payroll incident tracker.

Follow-Up
The employee's manager received coaching on campaign shift approvals and cutoff compliance.

Reference Documents
- Payroll Operations Procedures 2025
